title: Unprovoked
summary: UNPROVO'KED, adjective 1. Not provoked; not incited; applied to persons. 2. Not proceeding from provocation or just cause; as an unprovoked attack.

inlines.v: UNPROVO'KED, adjective 1. Not provoked; not incited; applied to persons. 2. Not proceeding from provocation or just cause; as an unprovoked attack.
